'''K-4NV''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed by [[Labor Valley Tram Station]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] of the [[Galactic War]], K-4NV relayed to Imperial forces a transmission from [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jiak]] regarding the renegade [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of the movement [[Directive 7]].<ref name="TOR:IV" />
